title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Jordan Reynolds
description: Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 behavior for KMS-backed keys and enforces region residency constraints for customer-managed KMS usage, while improving audit logging to provide deterministic, high-fidelity traces for compliance. Motivation: several customers flagged ambiguous KMS region routing and missing audit fields during SOC2 reviews (see SUP-9876); this change prevents cross-region key usage, surfaces policy evaluation results in audit logs, and tightens default RBAC checks. Changes: 1) policy evaluator: add kms_residency check and deny-by-default path when customer has residency policy; 2) kms integration layer: validate key.region against resource.region and reject requests with clear error codes; 3) audit logger: add fields (policy_id, evaluation_result, kms_key_id, kms_key_region, residency_enforced) to structured audit events; 4) migration: add linear job to backfill recent denied events into audit index for compliance queries; 5) configuration: new feature flag enable_rbac_v2_kms_residency (off by default for 2 weeks); 6) documentation and SDK error mapping updates. Rollout plan: gated feature flag -> internal staging tests -> canary on Dedicated for customers opted-in -> 2-week global rollout -> GA. Backwards compatibility: default-off guardrail, clear error responses to callers, SDK mapping updated. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests with mock KMS, [x] audit index backfill job, [x] docs and release notes, [x] security review done.
